        function eraseCookie(name) {
            var hostname = window.location.hostname;

            var domains = [];

The Combination Tu-Tone option combined the Special Tu-Tone and the Deluxe Tu-Tones, making for a uniquely desgined Bronco.</p>\n"},"2571":{"id":"1979-ford-bronco-ranger-xlt-2","ariaLabel":"","title":"Image Details","description":"<p>1978 Ford Bronco® Ranger XLT in Raven Black with Free Wheeling Package. The 1978 Bronco featured an updated front end with a new grille design.</p>\n"},"2572":{"id":"1978-ford-bronco","ariaLabel":"","title":"Image Details","description":"<p>One of the biggest changes to the 1978 Bronco® was in the suspension system. Ford added an optional dual front shock setup called quad shocks, for the front suspension. In addition to the quad-shock setup, Ford increased the stock shock piston diameter from 1 to 1-3/8 inches for increased damping control.</p>\n"},"2573":{"id":"1978-ford-bronco-ranger-xlt","ariaLabel":"","title":"Image Details","description":"<p>1978 brought two standard V8 engines for the Bronco® lineup - the 351M and the 400. The 351M provided 156hp and 262 ft-lbs. of torque. The 400 engine provided 158hp and 276 ft.-lbs. of torque.</p>\n"},"2574":{"id":"1978-ford-bronco-2","ariaLabel":"","title":"Image Details","description":"<p>Behind the two V-8 engines offered for the generation 2 Broncos there was a 4-speed manual transmission behind it for the first time on a Bronco. Automatic transmission was available with both part-time and full-time 4WD systems.</p>\n"},"2575":{"id":"bronco-target-big-bend-disclaimer-update","ariaLabel":"","title":"Image Details","description":"<p>2026 Ford Bronco Sport® Big Bend® model with optional features and extra-cost color option.</p>\n"},"2576":{"id":"1982-ford-bronco-interior","ariaLabel":"","title":"Image Details","description":"<p>1982 Ford Bronco® XLS Interior with optional captain’s chairs.</p>\n"},"2577":{"id":"1987-ford-eddie-bauer-bronco","ariaLabel":"","title":"Image Details","description":"<p>1987 Ford Eddie Bauer Bronco® Edition in Raven Black over Light Chestnut.</p>\n"},"2578":{"id":"1989-ford-bronco","ariaLabel":"","title":"Image Details","description":"<p>1989 Ford Bronco® with Victoria Two-Tone Paint.</p>\n"},"2579":{"id":"1987-ford-bronco-custom-2","ariaLabel":"","title":"Image Details","description":"<p>1987 Ford Bronco® Custom has a rugged and capable performer on or off the road. Twin-Traction Beam independent front suspension contributes to Bronco’s smooth ride.</p>\n"},"2580":{"id":"1987-ford-bronco-2","ariaLabel":"","title":"Image Details","description":"<p>1987 Ford Bronco® featured a power liftgate window standard on all Broncos.</p>\n"},"2581":{"id":"1996-ford-bronco","ariaLabel":"","title":"Image Details","description":"<p>1996 Ford Bronco® shown in Pacific Green Clearcoat Metallic. In 1992, owners would receive an Eddie Bauer garment bag and duffel bag with purchase.</p>\n"},"2595":{"id":"1995-ford-eddie-bauer-bronco-interior","ariaLabel":"","title":"Image Details","description":"<p>There were lots of ways to personalize an Eddie Bauer Bronco®, such as choosing an available premium electronic stereo system with compact disc player.             // If hostname has subdomains, loop and collect all levels

Ford Mobile Service is a convenient and complimentary way to get your new or used vehicle serviced right at your home or office with our Ford Mobile Service technicians. Yes, Ford Mobile Service technicians are Ford factory-trained and certified. Do all Ford dealers offer Ford Mobile Service? Ford Mobile Service is offered by participating dealers and may be limited based on availability, distance, or other dealer-specified criteria. Customer Viewpoint Ratings and Reviews

close Customer Viewpoint Ratings and Reviews

Who leaves ratings and reviews?

Ratings and reviews are provided by customers who have either purchased a vehicle or visited a dealership for service.

How are ratings and reviews collected?

Customers are invited to participate in a survey administered by MaritzCX, an independent, third-party supplier.

Can dealerships edit or remove reviews?

No. Ford personnel and/or dealership personnel cannot modify or remove reviews.

Are reviews modified or monitored before being published?

MaritzCX moderates public reviews to ensure they contain content that meet Review guidelines, such as:

‣No Profanity or inappropriate defamatory remarks

‣Fraud

‣No Personal Identifying information (e.g., customer phone number or email)

‣No Competitor references (e.g., another brand or dealership)

‣Dangerous behavior (e.g. threatening to harm employees or others)

‣Lack of adequate text (e.g., symbols, emoji’s and random letters)

Reviews on the product and not the customer’s Sales or Service experience

Customer Viewpoint Ratings and Reviews

close Customer Viewpoint Ratings and Reviews

Who leaves ratings and reviews?

Ratings and reviews are provided by customers who have either purchased a vehicle or visited a dealership for service.

How are ratings and reviews collected?

Customers are invited to participate in a survey administered by MaritzCX, an independent, third-party supplier.

Can dealerships edit or remove reviews?

No. Ford personnel and/or dealership personnel cannot modify or remove reviews.

Are reviews modified or monitored before being published?

MaritzCX moderates public reviews to ensure they contain content that meet Review guidelines, such as:

‣No Profanity or inappropriate defamatory remarks

‣Fraud

‣No Personal Identifying information (e.g., customer phone number or email)

‣No Competitor references (e.g., another brand or dealership)

‣Dangerous behavior (e.g. threatening to harm employees or others)

‣Lack of adequate text (e.g., symbols, emoji’s and random letters)

Reviews on the product and not the customer’s Sales or Service experience
